properties.notes: Opportunity for redevelopment of council-owned site within the existing urban area. Occupied by buildings formerly providing a learning facility but now derelict following closure. It is likely that clearance would be needed prior to redevelopment. Indicative yield could be at the lower end of range given urban environment, particularly if there is potential for conversion as well as new-build development. Despite refusal of the above application, the site is still considered to offer redevelopment potential.
